about_the_game:
🚐 Minibus Simulator

Build your own minibus business and experience the daily rhythm of the city behind the wheel.

Pick up passengers from bus stops, deliver them safely and on time, and grow your minibus career step by step.

But driving is only part of the job.

You will leave your vehicle, load passenger luggage, refuel your minibus, change tires and take care of your vehicle like a real driver.

🎮 Steering Wheel Support

Steering wheel support is available. If your device is not detected automatically, you can configure it using the in-game setup wizard.

🎓 Get Your License and Become a Minibus Driver

Your minibus career starts at home.

• Go to the training center and pass the driving tests

• Get your minibus driver license

• Take a loan from the bank

• Visit the dealership and buy your first minibus suitable for your level

Now it's time to get behind the wheel.

👥 Pick Up Passengers and Start Earning

• Choose a route and start your engine

• Pick up passengers from bus stops

• Deliver them safely and on time to their destination

Some passengers travel with luggage.

You can earn extra money by getting out of the vehicle and loading their bags into the trunk yourself.

You can also take standing passengers to increase your income…

…but be careful.

🚓 If the police catch you during an inspection, you might get fined.

⭐ Progress and Grow Your Business

Complete tasks, level up and grow your business.

• Unlock new minibuses

• Work on more profitable routes

🔧 Take Care of Your Vehicle

Your minibus is your livelihood.

• Take it to service when maintenance is needed

• Refuel it yourself and pay at the market

• Rough roads may damage your tires

If a tire bursts:

• Buy a new tire from the tire shop

• Replace it yourself on the vehicle

Dusty roads will make your minibus dirty.

If you want, you can:

🚿 Wash it yourself with a pressure washer

🚗 Or use an automatic car wash

Remember…

If you take good care of your minibus, it will take good care of your business.

🚐 Expand Your Fleet

Use the money you earn to buy new vehicles.

• Carry more passengers with larger minibuses

Become the best minibus driver in the city.

🗺️ Explore the World

A large map with different atmospheres awaits you.

• City center

• Coastal roads

• Peaceful villages

• Forest routes

• Holiday districts

Get behind the wheel — or step out and explore the world on foot.
requirements_minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6 GB or AMD Radeon RX 580 8 GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: N/A
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended.
requirements_recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400 or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 Super, RTX 2060 or AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: N/A
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended.
